text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear intro with thesis and signposted reasons","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how well the essay structures its ideas into an introduction, body reasons, and conclusion that are easy to follow."},{"evidence":"“The first reason… The second and probably most important reason…”","quality":"logical development","description":"This captures how clearly the essay builds and connects points with explicit progression from one reason to the next."},{"evidence":"“students do not retain information…”, “mental health”, “year-round school year”","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"This captures the use of more formal school-related language and abstract terms to express ideas."},{"evidence":"“mandatory (but simple) assignments… so that they don't forget this information”","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures how the essay extends an argument by offering a specific solution rather than stopping at a claim."},{"evidence":"“If this were the case than the brain of the student would eventually just break and shut down.”","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to produce more controlled complex sentences, even when minor errors remain."},{"evidence":"“An article, by Complex News…”","quality":"evidentiary support","description":"This captures the use of outside information to support a claim instead of relying only on personal opinion."}]}
